A control system influences a process or plant. A disturbance changes the process without being requested. In a feedback system, a sensor measures output so the controller can compare it with the setpoint.

![Reference block diagrams for open loop, closed loop, PID, and CNC systems.](/assets/tej/Control_Systems_Reference.svg){fig-alt="Block diagrams show command through controller and plant for open loop, feedback returning measured output in closed loop, P I D actions, and the CAD to CNC machine chain." width=100%}

$$e=r-y$$

| Symbol | Meaning |
|:--:|:--|
| $r$ | setpoint |
| $y$ | measured output |
| $e$ | error |
| $u$ | controller output |
